notes: Runs on a fixture project whose docs/requirements/ holds 3 Thai documents about an office-supply requisition system, seeded with one deliberate conflict (approval flow: single-level vs two-level above 5,000 THB) and one deliberate gap (no per-requisition item/amount limit stated). Eval 3 uses a fixture variant that already has docs/requirements-brief/. Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input. The grader must read the transcript, not only the produced files.

evals.name: happy-path-brief
evals.prompt: อ่าน requirement ใน docs/requirements แล้วทำ brief แยกเป็น feature ให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Creates docs/requirements-brief/00-overview.md plus one numbered file per feature, all in Thai. The overview carries system purpose, user types, feature table with dependencies, candidate tables, cross-cutting concerns, system-level open questions, and a Sources list covering every input file. The seeded approval-flow conflict appears as an open question naming both source documents; the seeded missing-limit gap appears as an open question. Closes with a handoff: build order, blocking questions, and a paste-ready next-step sentence. No application code or schema files are written.
assertions: At least 3 feature brief files exist besides the overview (requisition/approval, stock, report)

The seeded approval conflict (02: single-level for every requisition vs 03: two-level above 5,000 THB) is raised as an Open Question citing both source documents — not silently resolved by picking one version
At least two genuine gaps the documents never answer are raised as Open Questions (e.g., login method, the ผู้จัดการฝ่าย role missing from 01 user table, per-requisition limits)
Brief prose is written in Thai (identifiers/table names may stay English)
The overview Sources section accounts for all three requirement files
Every feature file has an Open Questions section
No application code, schema, or scaffold files are written — only the brief

evals.name: boundary-plain-question
evals.prompt: ระบบนี้มีผู้ใช้กี่แบบ ดูจากเอกสารใน docs/requirements ให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Answers the question directly in chat from the documents (four user types) without creating docs/requirements-brief/ or any other file — the skill's own boundary clause says a quick question about the documents is answered directly.
assertions: No files are created or modified — docs/requirements-brief/ does not exist after the run
The answer names the 4 user types from 01-overview.md
The answer is given directly in chat — the run does not launch into brief generation

evals.name: rerun-asks-first
evals.prompt: requirement มีอัปเดต ช่วยทำ brief ใหม่ให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Detects that docs/requirements-brief/ already exists, reports what is there, and asks the user whether to regenerate everything or only add new features — it does not silently overwrite the existing brief files.
assertions: The pre-existing brief files (00-overview.md, 01-requisition.md) are NOT modified — byte-identical to the fixture versions
The final output is a question to the user: regenerate everything vs update only what changed — it reports what the existing brief contains
No new brief files are written before the user answers
